title: Dark mode with theme tokens

requirements.text: Semantic color tokens have light and dark values, selectable by an attribute or class
Components reference only defined theme tokens, never hard-coded colors
Without a saved choice, the theme follows prefers-color-scheme and updates when it changes
A user's choice persists and is applied before first paint, without a flash of the wrong theme
The theme toggle is a labelled, keyboard-operable control that announces its state
Text and UI token pairs meet WCAG AA contrast in both themes
color-scheme is set so native form controls and scrollbars match the theme

evidence.name: every web stylesheet variable resolves to a supplied semantic theme token
every web stylesheet variable resolves to a supplied semantic theme token

implementations.notes: CSS variables with data-genlib-theme light/dark; its contract states there is no persistence, OS-theme listener or contrast certification

notes: capability:wcag-contrast can check token pairs, but no test applies it to the theme palettes.
